scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "hardhat,postgres,ipfs,graph,subgraph,webapp" -c "yellow,blue,magenta,cyan,green,white" "yarn dev:contracts" "yarn dev:postgres" "yarn dev:ipfs" "yarn dev:graph-node" "yarn dev:subgraph" "yarn dev:webapp"
scripts.dev:postgres: docker run --name nouns-postgres -e POSTGRES_USER=graph-node -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=let-me-in -e POSTGRES_DB=graph-node -p 5432:5432 -d postgres:14
scripts.setup:local: yarn install && yarn prepare && yarn contracts:deploy:local && yarn subgraph:deploy:local
scripts.subgraph:deploy:local: cd packages/nouns-subgraph && yarn codegen && yarn build && yarn create-local && yarn deploy-local
scripts.start:infra: yarn start:postgres && yarn start:ipfs && yarn start:graph-node
scripts.start:postgres: docker run --name nouns-postgres -e POSTGRES_USER=graph-node -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=let-me-in -e POSTGRES_DB=graph-node -e POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS='-E UTF8 --locale=C' -p 5432:5432 -d postgres:14 2>/dev/null || echo 'PostgreSQL already running'
scripts.start:ipfs: docker run --name nouns-ipfs -p 5001:5001 -p 8080:8080 -d ipfs/go-ipfs:v0.10.0 2>/dev/null || echo 'IPFS already running'
scripts.start:graph-node: docker run --name nouns-graph-node -p 8000:8000 -p 8001:8001 -p 8020:8020 -p 8030:8030 -p 8040:8040 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e postgres_host=host.docker.internal -e postgres_user=graph-node -e postgres_pass=let-me-in -e postgres_db=graph-node -e ipfs=host.docker.internal:5001 -e ethereum=mainnet:http://host.docker.internal:8545 -e GRAPH_LOG=info -d graphprotocol/graph-node 2>/dev/null || echo 'Graph Node already running'
scripts.start:contracts: cd packages/nouns-contracts && yarn install && npx hardhat node
scripts.start:subgraph: sleep 15 && cd packages/nouns-subgraph && yarn install && yarn prepare:hardhat && yarn codegen && yarn build && yarn create:localnode nounsdao/nouns-subgraph && yarn deploy:localnode nounsdao/nouns-subgraph
scripts.start:webapp: sleep 30 && cd packages/nouns-webapp && yarn install && yarn start
scripts.stop:infra: docker stop nouns-postgres nouns-ipfs nouns-graph-node 2>/dev/null || true && docker rm nouns-postgres nouns-ipfs nouns-graph-node 2>/dev/null || true
